# Spark your next story with DeepSeek in 5 minutes

You’ll walk away with three ready-to-use story starters you can drop into any blank page, perfect for jumpstarting your next creative project. No writing experience needed—just curiosity and a few clicks.

## Before you start
- A free DeepSeek account: If you don’t have one, visit [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com) and sign up using your email or a linked account. It's free to use for this task.
- A device with internet access: This guide works on a computer, tablet, or smartphone through a web browser.
- A blank document or note-taking app: Have a separate document open (like Google Docs, Word, or Apple Notes) where you can paste your ideas.
- Roughly 10 minutes: This process is quick and designed to get your creative juices flowing fast.

## Step 1 — Start a fresh chat
Begin by opening DeepSeek Chat in your web browser and making sure you have a clean slate.
When you go to [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com), you’ll usually see a chat window in the middle of your screen, possibly with a previous conversation if you've used it before. Look for a "New Chat" button or icon, often located in the top-left corner of the page, or sometimes as a large button in the center of the screen if you've just signed in. Click this to clear any old discussions.
A new, empty chat interface will appear, ready for your input. This ensures DeepSeek starts with a clean memory for your story ideas, without getting confused by past topics.
If you don't see a "New Chat" button, look for an icon that looks like a plus sign (+) or a square with a pencil, usually near the top of the conversation list. Clicking it will achieve the same result.
You'll know it worked when the main chat area is clear, with a simple text box at the bottom prompting you to "Type your message here..." or similar, indicating a new conversation thread has begun.
💬 Example: (No text input for this step, just clicking a button)

## Step 2 — Ask for story "seeds"
Now it's time to ask DeepSeek for some initial story ideas, often called "story seeds" because they are small, potent beginnings that can grow into full stories.
Locate the text input box at the bottom of the chat window. This is where you'll type your "prompt," which is simply the instruction you give to the AI. Type your request clearly and press Enter or click the send button (which often looks like a paper airplane icon). DeepSeek’s AI model, like a super-smart assistant, will then process your request and start generating its response.
If the text box seems too small, you can usually drag its top edge upwards to make more room for typing.
You'll know it worked when DeepSeek begins typing a response above your prompt, usually line by line, presenting three distinct story ideas based on your request.
💬 Example:
> Give me three short story seeds: one with a surprising plot twist, one with a vivid character bio, and one with a rich setting prompt. Keep each under 50 words.

## Step 3 — Choose and copy your favorite idea
DeepSeek will present you with three concise story ideas, each following your request for a twist, character, or setting.
Carefully read through each "seed" that DeepSeek has generated. Think about which one sparks your imagination the most – which one makes you wonder "what happens next?" the most vividly. Once you've chosen your favorite, highlight the text of that specific story seed with your mouse or finger (like you would any other text on a screen) and then copy it. You can usually right-click (on a computer) or long-press (on a phone/tablet) to bring up the "Copy" option.
If the ideas aren't quite right, you can simply type "Generate three more ideas, please" into the chat box and press Enter, and DeepSeek will offer new suggestions.
You'll know it worked when the selected text is copied to your device's clipboard, ready to be pasted elsewhere, meaning you have a strong starting point ready to develop.
💬 Example:
*(Example DeepSeek reply you might see on screen)*
- Twist: A quiet astronomer discovers an alien signal that perfectly matches her deceased father's favorite lullaby.
- Character: Elara, a shy barista, can subtly change the color of flowers by humming specific tunes.
- Setting: A hidden library where every book is alive, whispering forgotten histories to anyone who listens after midnight.
*(You would then copy one of these, for instance: "A quiet astronomer discovers an alien signal that perfectly matches her deceased father's favorite lullaby.")*

## Step 4 — Expand your chosen idea in the same chat
Now that you have your favorite story seed, let's ask DeepSeek to flesh it out a bit more.
In the same chat window, where your previous conversation and DeepSeek’s generated ideas are still visible, type a new prompt into the text input box. This time, you'll ask DeepSeek to expand on the specific idea you copied. Make sure your new prompt directly references the idea you chose and gives DeepSeek a clear instruction, such as a desired length or focus. Press Enter to send it. DeepSeek will then take your previous context and the new instruction to generate a more detailed scene or description.
If DeepSeek's reply feels a bit short or doesn't go in the direction you wanted, try rephrasing your follow-up prompt with more details, like "Can you make it more mysterious?" or "Focus on the astronomer's feelings."
You'll know it worked when DeepSeek responds with a longer piece of text, usually around 100 words, that elaborates on the single story seed you asked it to expand.
💬 Example:
> Expand the astronomer story into a 100-word opening scene, focusing on her shock and curiosity.

## Step 5 — Save your expanded scene and make it your own
You now have a more developed story starter. It’s time to move it to your personal document and add your unique touch.
Once DeepSeek provides the expanded scene, highlight the entire text of DeepSeek's response and copy it. Then, switch over to the blank document or note-taking app you prepared earlier. Paste the copied text into your document. This is crucial because DeepSeek Chat doesn’t automatically save long-term project files, so moving it ensures you don’t lose your work. Once it's in your document, feel free to change any detail that doesn't quite resonate with you. Remember, DeepSeek is a tool to spark ideas, not to replace your creativity entirely.
If the text doesn't paste correctly, ensure you properly highlighted and copied it in DeepSeek, then try pasting again using Ctrl+V (Windows) or Cmd+V (Mac). DeepSeek is excellent at generating text, but it won't store your documents or actively edit files outside its interface.
You'll know it worked when the expanded scene is successfully pasted into your document, and you've made at least one small edit, like changing a character's name or a setting detail, making it truly yours.
💬 Example tweak:
> (After pasting) "Instead of an astronomer, I'll make her a lonely lighthouse keeper who hears the lullaby on a crackling radio."

## Common mistakes
- **Asking for a whole novel at once:** DeepSeek, like many AI models, works best when you break down large requests into smaller, manageable "chunks."
    - **Fix:** Start with broad "story seeds" or outlines, then ask DeepSeek to expand specific parts, like a character's dialogue or a setting description, one step at a time.
- **Being too vague in your prompt:** If your instructions are unclear, DeepSeek might give you generic or unhelpful responses.
    - **Fix:** Add specific details to your prompts, like desired length ("under 50 words," "100-word scene"), tone ("mysterious," "humorous"), or specific elements you want included.
- **Forgetting to save your favorite ideas:** DeepSeek Chat saves your conversations within its interface, but it's not a word processor for long-term projects.
    - **Fix:** Always copy and paste your most promising ideas and expanded scenes into your personal document or note-taking app immediately. This way, you control your work and won't lose it if you start a new chat or close your browser.

## What this means for you
-   **In everyday life:** If you're stuck on a birthday card message or need a unique social media caption, ask DeepSeek for a six-word story related to the occasion. It's a great way to add a personal, creative touch.
-   **For your business or work:** Need a punchy opening for a presentation, a creative concept for a marketing campaign, or a quick anecdote for a team meeting? DeepSeek can help you brainstorm compelling hooks or scenarios in minutes.
-   **If you're just getting started:** Treat every chat with DeepSeek as a "creative vending machine." You type in what you're looking for (your prompt), get a few ideas (the seeds), pick your favorite, and then expand on it. Keep experimenting with different prompts to see what it can do!

## Try it now
Open [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com), paste the prompt from Step 2 into a new chat, and copy the first story seed that sparks your imagination. You’ll have your first 50 words of inspiration in under two minutes!
